verdict.rationale: Loops documents a dedicated POST /transactional endpoint that sends emails with data variables and attachments. It explicitly positions transactional messages (password resets, login codes, receipts) as sent from the same platform and API as marketing campaigns, with typed SDKs, CLI and MCP access, and transactional sending included on paid plans. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending (community evidence speaks only to general ease of use), and attachments require enablement by Loops support.
